description: This PHP class 'MembershipMenuConfigurator' implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface and is responsible for configuring menu items related to the 'membership' feature within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It utilizes traits for module screen helpers and overrides the screen to 'membership'.

classes.name: MembershipMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for the 'membership' module, overriding the screen to 'membership'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the menu for the given screen by overriding it to 'membership' and returns null.
